card.line: Sidon was an old Phoenician harbor city on the Mediterranean coast, known for trade, and it appears in the stories of Elijah, Jesus, and Paul.

moments.title: Elijah sent to Zarephath of Sidon
moments.text: When the brook dried up, the LORD told Elijah to go to Zarephath of Sidon. A widow there shared her last flour and oil, and the jar and jug did not run out.

moments.title: A Canaanite woman's faith
moments.text: Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon, where a Canaanite woman begged Him to help her daughter. He praised her great faith, and her daughter was healed.

moments.title: Jesus passes through Sidon
moments.text: Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon on His way to the Sea of Galilee and the Decapolis.

moments.title: Paul visits friends
moments.text: On the way to Italy, Paul's ship landed at Sidon. Julius, the Roman army officer in charge of Paul, let him visit his friends and receive their care.
